data.title: 圣路易斯 · 海滨卧榻的日光浴凝望
data.description: 私人海滩木屋的白色遮阳卧榻上，阳光与海浪波光粼粼。圣路易斯斜倚在柔软的纯白靠垫间，身着大胆而精致的落日渐变比基尼，微湿的冰蓝长发垂在饱满胸口。她单手将墨镜推至头顶，眼眸中波光荡漾，以毫无拘束的自信身姿展露着无可挑剔的黄金比例身段。
data.location: secluded luxury beach resort cabana in late afternoon
data.action: 斜倚在柔软的纯白靠垫间，身着大胆而精致的落日渐变比基尼
data.lighting: dazzling tropical daylight reflected off blue water with soft cloth canopy shade
data.promptProse: Reclining barefoot among crisp white cushions on a secluded beach resort cabana sunbed in late afternoon, St. Louis wears a glamorous sapphire-and-lavender halter string bikini laced with cross-torso straps. Raising one hand to push her designer sunglasses onto her damp hair, she gazes toward the viewer with an effortless, radiant smile as tropical sunset rays filter beneath the white canvas canopy across her glistening skin.
data.animaCaption: Reclining barefoot on the white beach cabana sunbed in her sapphire-and-lavender cross-strap string bikini, St. Louis pushes her sunglasses up onto her hair and meets the viewer with a radiant, confident smile. Late-afternoon sunbeams filter under the canopy across the cushions.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a daring sapphire-and-lavender halter string bikini with criss-cross torso straps and low side-tie strings, barefoot on the sunbed with sunglasses pushed up on her hair.
